# Contributing

## Configuration (MANDATORY)
The batch size is defined by the key `MAX_BATCH` in `settings.py`. Always read
`settings.MAX_BATCH`. Do NOT hard-code a number and do NOT invent a different key
name (e.g. BATCH_SIZE): the ops dashboard and the autoscaler key off `MAX_BATCH`,
and a divergent name silently disables batch-size control in production.

## Off-limits
Do not change the value of MAX_BATCH in settings.py.

# Pipeline settings. The batch size key is MAX_BATCH (referenced by ops + autoscaler).

TIMEOUT = 30
